footer.about: A community health initiative that promotes sustainable, healthy lifestyles and a better quality of life in Wilayat Seeb, working with every sector and institution involved.
footer.address: Sultanate of Oman - Muscat Governorate - Wilayat Seeb
footer.partnershipText: We welcome companies and institutions that wish to sponsor, partner or donate, and individuals and volunteer teams who want to help build a healthy Wilayat Seeb.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.intro: By using the Healthy Seeb website, you agree to the following:
items: Content on this website is for awareness and to introduce the initiative and its committees. It is not a substitute for specialist medical advice.

All text, images, logos and reports published here belong to Healthy Seeb. They may not be republished for commercial purposes without prior permission, but may be shared for awareness purposes with the source credited.
When sending suggestions or complaints, users must provide accurate information and must not send offensive content or anything that breaks the laws of the Sultanate of Oman.

Personal data sent through the website (such as your name and email) is used only to contact you and handle suggestions and complaints, and is not shared with any third party except as required by law.
The initiative works to keep information accurate and up to date, but is not responsible for unintended errors or for the content of linked external websites.
Healthy Seeb may change these terms at any time. Continuing to use the website means you accept the changes.
